candidate: Red Tiger Daily Drop / 10 Minute Drop
objective: Determine whether the late-time increase in player-level jackpot win probability can raise conservative total RTP above 100% in a Spain-licensed configuration.

spainPresence.scope: Red Tiger Daily Drop feature is advertised by Spain-facing licensed operators; exact participating game/configuration still requires binding.

sources.fact: The Red Tiger catalogue page explicitly lists Daily Drop Jackpots as a Red Tiger feature available to users.
The Spain-facing slot catalogue describes Red Tiger Daily Drop Jackpots as guaranteed awards distributed before a specified time each day.

facts: Red Tiger created the Daily Drop Jackpots Network.
The network distributes hourly and daily jackpots across participating games.
The timed jackpot is guaranteed to pay before a set date/time.
Winning odds increase as the guaranteed latest payout time approaches.
The rules state odds increase up to 100% when the guaranteed latest payout time is reached.
A jackpot can be triggered and won by one spin and one player only.
The configuration contains Daily time, Progressive, and 10 Minute Drop time tiers.
The same rules document says RTP shown in help includes base-game RTP plus jackpot contribution.
The same configuration states 2% of stake for jackpots, but this value MUST NOT be imported into Spain without exact configuration evidence.

derivedScreen.interpretation: In this comparator only, a player-level late-time jackpot return above 9.72% would make total RTP exceed 100%; this is a screening target, not evidence that Spain or any current live state reaches it.

conservativeProbabilityScreens.assumptions: Comparator base RTP 90.28%, stake EUR 0.20, timed jackpot EUR 50, all other jackpot value ignored.
Comparator base RTP 90.28%, stake EUR 0.20, timed jackpot EUR 100, all other jackpot value ignored.
Comparator base RTP 90.28%, stake EUR 0.20, timed jackpot EUR 10000, all other jackpot value ignored.

liveDataLead.claim: Public page says it tracks live Red Tiger Daily/Progressive/10 Minute values and every recorded drop timestamp/amount.
liveDataLead.use: DISCOVERY_ONLY until feed provenance, network equivalence and timestamps are independently validated.

exactBlockers: Bind one currently available Spain-licensed Red Tiger game to the Daily/10 Minute network.
Recover that exact Spain game's RTP variant and base-vs-jackpot decomposition, or a conservative base RTP excluding the jackpot component.
Recover or prospectively estimate player-level win probability by time-to-deadline and stake; network drop probability alone is insufficient.
Verify exact stake weighting/eligible-stake cap in Spain.
Verify current live countdown and jackpot value from the same Spain network/configuration.
Account for network concurrency/winner ordering so qualification probability is not confused with this player's win probability.

decision.reason: The break-even hurdle is numerically plausible in comparator configurations and timed odds are documented to rise to 100% at the deadline, but Spain-specific player-level hazard and RTP decomposition are not yet verified.
